verdict.rationale: Postmark documents a Stats API for delivery, open, and click statistics, a Bounce API, per-server and per-email open tracking, and a paid DMARC monitoring add-on. That covers raw bounce and engagement analytics and some domain-authentication monitoring, but nothing shows interpretive guidance beyond counts. Missing for 10: explicit spam-complaint analytics, inbox-placement guidance or testing, sender-reputation scoring or recommendations, and hands-on corroboration of dashboard depth.

support.subject: As a deliverability manager, I can see bounce, complaint, and engagement analytics with guidance on inbox placement and sender reputation, not just raw counts
